findings.evidence: Cart line for Tacos XXL (4 Viandes) at 18,00 € shows ONLY '+ 1 suppléments' as composition summary. Full configuration (Merguez/Kefta/Cordon Bleu/Tenders, Ketchup+Mayonnaise, Oignon retiré, Œuf, Menu complet +3€, Coca-Cola 33cl, Cheddar fondu, Barbecue) is absent from the cart display. Visible text extracted from 25-tacos-cart-after-add.dom.html (stripped): 'Tacos XXL (4 Viandes) + 1 suppléments − 1 + 18,00 €'. Customer cannot verify a 18 € order before pressing 'Valider ma commande'.
findings.fix_hint: ScreenCart cart-line renderer needs a composition_summary line (mobile/screens/screen-cart.jsx). Mirror what state 24 recap shows — viandes joined by ' · ', sauces by ' / ', supplements with '+' prefix, menu+drink+frites cascade. Cap at 2 lines with ellipsis.

findings.evidence: Le Terminator recap (state 31, 9,00 €) renders only VIANDES + SAUCE rows. CRUDITÉS row missing despite user passing through state 28 (defaults Salade/Tomate/Oignon ON). SUPPLÉMENTS row missing despite step 29 traversal (skipped/empty). FORMULE row missing despite explicit 'Sans formule' selection in state 30. Customer cannot verify which crudités are included nor confirm 'no formule' choice before checkout.
findings.fix_hint: screens-item-steps.jsx ScreenStepRecap should render every step the user passed, even when value=defaults or value=null. Show 'CRUDITÉS: Salade · Tomate · Oignon', 'SUPPLÉMENTS: aucun', 'FORMULE: Sans formule'. Avoid silent omission.

findings.evidence: Cheese Burger recap (state 36, 6,00 €) renders only SAUCE row. CRUDITÉS row missing (state 33 traversed with defaults). SUPPLÉMENTS row missing (state 34 traversed). FORMULE row missing (state 35 picked 'Sans formule'). Same omission pattern as B-002 reproduced on burger template — recap drops every step whose value equals defaults or 'none'.
findings.fix_hint: Same fix as B-002 in ScreenStepRecap. Render all traversed steps unconditionally, with a sentinel like 'inchangé' / 'aucun' / 'Sans formule' when the choice is the default.

findings.evidence: Le Terminator description '2 viandes au choix + 2 Cheddar + Œuf + Jambon ...' is hard-clipped at the right viewport edge (no ellipsis glyph, no tooltip, text content extends past container bound). Le Cayenne description 'Viande hachée ou chicken + mozzarella + chedda...' similarly cut mid-word. Critical for purchase decision — user cannot read full ingredient list before opening the wizard.
findings.fix_hint: Menu list card description span needs CSS overflow handling: `white-space: normal; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;` plus `title` attr fallback so the full string is reachable on long-press.

findings.evidence: React level=error warning fires only on the Crudités step (state 18): 'Updating a style property during rerender (textDecoration) when a conflicting property is set (textDecorationColor) can lead to styling bugs.' Stack: ChoiceCard (<anonymous>:353) → ScreenStepCrudites (<anonymous>:578) → ScreenItemWizard. Not in vendor.js, not Pusher noise. Single state with this error — the strike-through line-through styling on a deselected crudité mixes shorthand `textDecoration: 'line-through'` and `textDecorationColor: <red>` causing React's style shorthand collision warning.
findings.fix_hint: In ChoiceCard (mobile/components/choice-card.jsx around line 353): replace shorthand `textDecoration: 'line-through'` with the longhand triple `textDecorationLine: 'line-through'`, then add `textDecorationColor` and `textDecorationStyle` on separate keys. React will stop warning and the strike-through will animate cleanly.

findings.evidence: Cart line literally renders '+ 1 suppléments' (plural form bound to n=1). Should be '+ 1 supplément' (singular) when count is 1. Visible in 25-tacos-cart-after-add.dom.html: `1 suppléments` is a literal substring of the rendered tree.
findings.fix_hint: Wherever ScreenCart formats the suppléments summary, use `${n} supplément${n > 1 ? 's' : ''}` or an i18n plural function. Same likely needed for 'article'/'articles' even though state 25 only had 1 line.

findings.evidence: All 60 menu list cards (every category screen + the global Tout list) render the product image as a dark grey-on-black square containing the product name in low-contrast text (e.g. 'Tacos M (1 Viande)' inset on a near-black square). Some cards add a `` picture-icon placeholder (state 07 Ojja, state 12 Frites, state 13 Desserts, state 14 Boissons). Result : the catalog never displays a single real product photograph, which is unprofessional for a food-delivery app and the placeholder text acts as visual masquerade (mimics a label inside an image). Visible across states 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 25.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) ship default emoji placeholders styled as proper hero icons (matching the chip emoji on each card), or (b) hide the dark-square image well entirely when no image_url is set and let the title+description+price expand into the freed space. Current state degrades trust.

findings.evidence: Home featured 'Tacos XXL' card displays a generic `` picture-placeholder icon on the right tile (yellow background, dashed border around a grey image glyph). The card is the highest-conversion CTA above the fold ('COMMANDER →') yet ships with a stock placeholder. First impression for a paying customer.
findings.fix_hint: Either bind the featured card image to a real asset (mobile/data/menu.js item.image_url) or fall back to an emoji-hero in matching brand palette (🌮) instead of the broken-image SVG.

findings.evidence: Step supplements price subline `+ 1,00 €` is rendered with a noticeably faded grey on cream-white (#F4EFE6). State 19 / state 29 / state 34 all show the same `+ 1,00 €` line at low contrast — appears <4.5:1 versus the 16-px text rule. Same visual issue on 'Sauce supplémentaire +0,50 €' bottom row.
findings.fix_hint: Bump the supplement-card price subline from current grey (~#9A8F7E suspected) to #5B5249 or #444 to satisfy WCAG AA. Validate with axe-core: each `.supplement-price` rule must score ≥4.5:1.

findings.evidence: Currency typography inconsistency: state 20 'Menu complet' card shows '+3,00€' (no space before €, no space after sign). State 19 Œuf supplement card shows '+ 1,00 €' (spaces around digits). Same currency, two formats, same wizard. Detectable at-a-glance UX rough edge.
findings.fix_hint: Pick one format (recommendation: '+3,00 €' with thin space before €, no space after '+') and apply via shared <Price /> component across ChoiceCard variants (radio + checkbox + recap).

findings.evidence: Filter chip rail does not auto-centre the active chip. State 10 (Poulet Croustillant) shows the previous chip 'NOS SALADES' clipped at the left edge ('S SALADES' visible). State 11 shows 'NOS M...' on the right edge (Menus Enfants/Frites neighbour clipped). User scrolling through 13 chips loses spatial context — no scroll indicator, no fade gradient on the edges, and tapping a chip near the edge requires manual horizontal scrolling.
findings.fix_hint: After each chip click, scrollIntoView({inline:'center', behavior:'smooth'}) on the active button. Add an `::after` gradient fade on both ends of the chip rail so users see there is more content.

findings.evidence: Cart screen header label '1 article · prêt dans ~12 min' renders a static prep-time estimate ('~12 min') that is hard-coded — there is no API call backing it (network.json is empty after the second reload), no business rule visible in the audit and no per-line aggregation logic. Adding a second item with a different prep time would not move the figure. The reward strip below ('+18 pts gagnés... 153 pts pour ton burger gratuit') is also magic: 18 pts on 18,00 € (1pt/€?) is plausible but the 153-pt-to-burger countdown is not anchored to any user state we observed.
findings.fix_hint: Either bind to a /api/cart/eta endpoint (returning a real estimate) or hide the ETA chip until the data is available. Same for loyalty: derive from the authed user balance, not a static string.

findings.evidence: Wizard dots progression renders as decorative `<span>`-like dots without `role=tablist` / `aria-current=step` semantics — screen readers narrate only 'ÉTAPE 5 / 9' from the heading, never the step name in the dots strip. There is no aria-live announcement when the step changes (states 16→17, 17→18 etc.). A keyboard user cannot Tab onto previous dots to jump back; the only back-affordance is the chevron button top-left.
findings.fix_hint: Add role='progressbar' aria-valuenow=5 aria-valuemax=9 on the dots container, and an `aria-live='polite'` region near the heading announcing 'Étape 5 sur 9, Faire un menu' on transition. Skip-back to a previous step is optional but should be exposed via the chevron's accessible name ('Étape précédente : Suppléments').
